principles: Use the standard bow from the saddle for harassment and shaping fire.
Charge only with favorable ground, cohesion and target disorder.
Use lance and shield for shock, then sword and shield once mounted reach collapses.
House Cavalry remains House Cavalry at every training level; veteran quality lives in cohort capability, not a prestige troop label.
doctrine.weapon_transition_rule: MOUNTED BOW -> LANCE + SHIELD -> SWORD + SHIELD
